config.notes: Two page kinds. (1) Curriculum catalogue pages at study.auckland.ac.nz/ords/r/uoa/catalogue/program?p5_code=<code>: Quick Facts (Duration, Available locations, Programme type); Fees table "<year> fees ... International Student Annual Fees NZ$ <low> - $ <high>" (the lower figure of the range is read); Key Dates table (year, period, application closing date, semester START date, end date) - only the start date is read. (2) Programme pages at www.auckland.ac.nz/en/study/study-options/find-a-study-option/<name>.html: header facts (Duration, Next start date, Available locations, Points, Programme type); fees and entry requirements are not in the captured page. No programme page carries IELTS: English is on the central international English language requirements page. NZ has no CRICOS code; patterns use stable labels only. International view (5 Oct): both page kinds print the international fee in the plain page for every visitor (no student-type switch or URL variant): programme pages "How much does a <programme> cost per year? <year> fees Domestic students NZ$x * International students NZ$y *" (read: y, per year) and catalogue pages "International Student Annual Fees NZ$ low - $ high" (lower figure). Delivery (mode) is read from "Available locations" (City, Grafton, Epsom, University of Auckland Online ...); campus names alone are not recognised as on campus by the delivery normaliser. | 5 Oct (exit awards and requirements): entry_requirement = programme page "Minimum programme requirements" grades after "...may require a higher grade to be offered a place." (study option, points, GPA, qualifying degree; PG pages only; the same for all applicants). UG pages link to a separate international entry requirements page. Exit options (PGCert/PGDip) are printed in points only and mostly have their own pages; no exit-award pattern. Fees are annual.
